A [[Talid/Legends|Talid]] who was known as '''Gra'pa''' to a peer lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ando Prime/Legends|Ando Prime]] as a monk of the [[Order of Dai Bendu]]. A tan-furred Talid with [[Color/Legends|white]] hair, Gra'pa had yellow [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] and wore heavy hooded robes with gold ornaments. In the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[36,453 BBY]], Gra'pa was one of several Talids who were near the [[Tho Yor]] pyramid that was buried in the [[Andobi Mountains/Legends|Andobi Mountains]] on Ando Prime when they felt the Tho Yor call out to them through [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. Heeding the Tho Yor's call, Gra'pa and the other [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] Talids nearby boarded the pyramid [[Starship/Legends|ship]] and were taken to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tython/Legends|Tython]], where pilgrims of many different [[Species/Legends|species]] had been gathered to study the Force.<ref name="DOTJ 1" />

==Behind the scenes==
Gra'pa first appeared in a flashback on the first page of the [[Star Wars comic books|comic book]] [[Dawn of the Jedi: Force Storm 1|''Dawn of the Jedi: Force Storm'' 1]], but the issue does not specify Gra'pa's [[Gender/Legends|gender]]. It is unknown if ''Gra'pa'' was a term of endearment, or a variation on the familial ''grandfather''.<ref name="DOTJ 1" />
